description.from: As a maintainer of the private repository, I want quality checks to run only on production Python 3.11 so that GitHub Actions minutes are conserved while retaining the full matrix configuration for restoration when the repository is public again.
description.to: As a maintainer of the private repository, I want quality checks to run only on production Python 3.11 and only for pull requests targeting main, while retaining the full matrix configuration for restoration when the repository is public again. Pushes to main remain enabled for post-merge semantic release.
